parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair made of plywood, typically rectangular and flat, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: The seat can fold upward along with the chair’s frame for compact storage, but remains fixed during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of steel tubing that supports the seat and backrest.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural stability and allows the chair to fold and unfold through its hinged joints.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot points that enable folding motion, allowing the chair to collapse for portability and storage.
